info.title: Yespark Group Partner API
info.description:
Zenpark has joined Yespark Group in 2025. This API documentation allows you to:

- search for parking spaces
- manage your users
- manage your reservations

See the [Changelog](#tag/changelog) for a history of breaking changes and additions.

# Requests

The API adheres to REST principles:

- `GET` requests: read data without modification
- `POST` requests: create a new resource
- `PATCH` requests: update an existing resource
- `DELETE` requests: delete a resource

Parameters for `GET` requests must be sent via the query string.

Parameters for `POST` requests must be included in the request body as valid JSON and must have the `Content-Type: application/json` header.

Parameter formats:

- `DATE`: "YYYY-MM-DD" (e.g., "2021-10-21")
- `TIME`: H:m[:s] (e.g., "10:30")
- `DATETIME`: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss" (e.g., "2025-07-25T07:46:56")

# Endpoints

For the production version, requests must be sent to `https://developers.zenpark.com`.

For the demo version, requests must be sent to `https://developers-preprod-env.zenpark.com`.

# Authentication

The API uses a token-based authentication system.

To authenticate, you need to provide a valid API key in the `Authorization` header of your request. You must use the `Bearer` scheme.

The API key is provided by Yespark Group.

# Serialization

The API only supports JSON. All API responses will have the `Content-Type: application/json` header, and the response body will contain JSON content to be deserialized.

# List Pagination

Most endpoints returning lists are paginated. Any endpoint returning a list may return an empty list.

## Parameters

The optional `pagination.pageNumber` parameter allows you to access a specific page. Unless otherwise specified, each page contains 20 items.

## Response

The response also contains a `pagination` object indicating the total number of pages and items, for example:

```json
{
  […],
  "pagination": {
    "sortField": "UserName",
    "sortDirection": "asc",
    "pageNumber": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "totalCount": 34,
    "totalPages": 2
  }
}
```

# Return Codes

The API may return the following status codes:

| Code  | Nom                   | Description                                                                      |
| ----  | --------              | --------                                                                         |
| `200` | Success               | Success                                                                          |
| `400` | Bad Request           | The request is invalid                                                           |
| `401` | Unauthorized          | Authentication failed                                                            |
| `403` | Forbidden             | Insufficient rights to perform the requested action                              |
| `404` | Not Found             | The resource is not found                                                        |
| `422` | Unprocessable Entity  | The data sent is malformatted                                                    |
| `429` | Too Many Requests     | Too many requests have been made                                                 |
| `500` | Internal Server Error | An internal server error occurred (the technical team is notified automatically) |

# Errors

For errors recognized by the system (e.g., 422 errors), the response will include the following fields to inform you about the issues:

- `errorCode` : a machine-readable error name (e.g., `USER_NOT_FOUND`)
- `message` : a human-readable error message (e.g., `User not found`)

tags.name: Changelog
tags.description:
- 2023-07-22: Initial version
- 2025-06-11: The API has been migrated to the Yespark Group platform. Hence, some endpoints may have changed, but the API is still compatible with the previous version.
- 2025-08-27: In the `POST /api/partner/members` endpoint, the `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `phoneNumber` parameters are now optional. Only the `userId` parameter is required.
- 2025-10-07: A new `/api/partner/parkings/:id/accesses` endpoint has been added to return all accesses of a parking. Also, the `accessInformation` content field has been sanitized to remove HTML tags.
- 2025-10-14: In the `POST /api/partner/reservations/reserve` endpoint, the `serviceFee` and `amount` parameters have been added to allow the partner to set the service fee and the total price that the customer pays to the partner.
- 2026-05-07: A new public **Embed Widget** has been added (`/embed/search`). It allows third-party websites to embed a parking search iframe without authentication. See the *Embed Widget* document.

### 2025-06-11

- The API path have changed from `/api/v3/` to `/api/partner/`. The legacy `/api/v3/` is still working through a Cloudflare worker transformation.
- Authentication method has changed. The API key is now provided by Yespark Group. Your account has a unique API key that you can find in the answer of the `/api/partner/auth` endpoint. The `/api/partner/auth/refresh` is now deprecated and not documented. It still works but returns the same result as the `/api/partner/auth` endpoint. You don't need to call the auth endpoint before each request.
- The following endpoints have been deprecated and are not documented:
  - `/api/partner/user_groups` as the backend logic is not used anymore
  - `/api/partner/search/subscriptions` as the backend logic was never used, but could be used in the future
- The `/api/partner/overtimes` endpoint has not been implemented yet, but it will be implemented in the next version.

### 2025-10-07

A new endpoint, `/api/partner/parkings/:id/accesses`, has been introduced to provide a comprehensive list of all accesses associated with a specific parking facility. This enhancement enables your application to display parking accesses exactly as they are configured in our backend, offering a more accurate and detailed representation compared to the previous summary fields (`CarEntry`, `CarExit`, and `Pedestrian`).

Each access object includes an `id` (an integer corresponding to our database identifier), a `name`, and a `kind`. The `kind` attribute can be one of the following values: `car_entry`, `car_exit`, or `pedestrian`.

When calling `/api/partner/parkings/:id/open-door`, the `accessId` parameter can be used to specify the access to open. If `accessId` is provided, the `openingReason` parameter is ignored.

Also, in the `POST /api/partner/reservations` endpoint, the `accessInformation` content field has been sanitized to remove HTML tags.

### 2025-10-14

In the `POST /api/partner/reservations/reserve` endpoint, the `serviceFee` and `amount` parameters have been added to allow the partner to set the service fee and the total price that the customer pays to the partner.

In the response, the `serviceFee` has been added alongside `amount` to return the service fee that the customer pays to the partner.

accessInformation.content: Pour entrer en voiture :Au 8 rue du Sentier, au niveau du panneau Yespark, ouvrir la grille coulissante COULEUR_GRILLE avec l'application (bouton « Grille voiture »). Emprunter la rampe véhicule et ouvrir la porte basculante COULEUR_PORTE avec l'application (bouton « Porte voiture »). Cheminer vers la place attribuée.

Pour sortir en voiture :Suivre le cheminement inverse à l'entrée voiture. Ouvrir la porte basculante avec l'application (bouton « Porte voiture ») ou avec le digicode mural (code indiqué dans l'application bouton « Porte voiture sortie »).

Pour entrer à pied :Au 8 rue du Sentier, à DROITE_GAUCHE de l'accès voiture, ouvrir la grille piéton COULEUR_GRILLE_PIETON avec l'application (bouton « Grille piéton ») puis dans la cour ouvrir la porte piéton avec l'application (bouton « Porte piéton »). Dans le hall de la résidence, ouvrir la porte menant au sous-sol, descendre les escaliers et ouvrir la porte du parking avec le digicode mural (code indiqué dans l'application bouton « Porte piéton -1 ») puis cheminer vers la place attribuée.Pour sortir à pied :Suivre le cheminement inverse à l'entrée piéton. L'emplacement le plus proche de la sortie piéton est le n°…Un seul cheminement piéton est équipé pour les utilisateurs Yespark. Merci de respecter les consignes ci-dessus, au risque d'être bloqué dans le parking.
